title: agentic.representations.v1 request
description: Body sent to a self-operated representation endpoint. Additive fields are permitted and ignored by older clients; a change that is not additive requires a new major version.

version.description: Protocol version. The major number is binding; a minor or patch suffix marks additive changes.

inputs.description: Texts to encode. The response carries exactly one item per entry, in this order.

input_type.description: Which side of a retrieval task the inputs sit on. Omitted or empty means neither.

outputs.description: Representations to compute. Explicit because a multi-vector response is orders of magnitude larger than a dense one, and no caller should pay for one by accident.

truncate.description: True clips an over-long input to the model's context window; false rejects it.
